scope: Offline saved embedded product JSON only; AU productImageUrls vs Rakuten media.images[].location. No network, image downloads, or byte hashes.
rule: Deduplicated complete gallery sets of lowercase filename stems (extensions removed) are equal; require at least 3 unique stems. AU Wowma proxy paths are unwrapped at image.wowma.jp/ before basename extraction.
caveat: Filename-stem set equality is deterministic filename evidence only; it does not prove image-byte identity or that image files remain current.
